title: Custom eggless birthday cakes ready by 7am for Riverstone, Vineyard, Tallawong
summary:
A Saturday party at 10am means the cake needs to be ready by 9. Most bakeries across the Hills District don't open until 8 or 9 on weekends — by then you're already behind.

Riverstone opens 7am Saturday and Sunday. Order a custom eggless birthday cake 48 hours ahead, and you collect it before the balloons go up — not while everyone's waiting on you.

Every cake is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake. Six sizes from $39.99, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, buttercream, fondant or ganache finish. Free parking right at the shopping centre.

Families across Riverstone, Vineyard and Tallawong already order this way. WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
